svg.aria-label: The single-sample depth image from frame N to frame N+1 at 4x: the scene pass's resolve writes it, RecordParticles' depth tests read it, and its hand-back barrier's destination is the early and late fragment tests. That chains into frame N+1's beginScenePass barrier, whose source names the same fragment-test stages and COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT.
